Additionally, the zebra arrangement is unnaturally linear and rigid, suggesting compositional artifact rather than organic herd behavior. Zebra leg striping shows some blurring/inconsistency near hooves. Despite these issues, the overall rendering quality is strong, warranting a moderate-high authenticity score.
